messages.title: Meet the Enshrouded modding community
messages.message: Join the Enshrouded Modding Discord to get help, connect with other players, and talk about modding.

messages.title: Welcome to ShroudForge
messages.message: Manage your mods and their settings in the Modloader. Mod packages live in the mods directory. A mod stays disabled unless enabled is explicitly set to true.

messages.title: Mod settings are stored in extended.mod.json
messages.message: Activation and user values are stored under enabled and settings in mods/<Mod>/extended.mod.json. You can edit this file without the UI, for example on a dedicated server.

messages.title: When do changes take effect?
messages.message: Saving a setting does not mean it is already active in the game. Runtime settings currently require a restart. Asset mods also require preparation while the game is closed.

messages.title: Report issues and help improve ShroudForge
messages.message: When reporting an issue, include your game version, enabled mods, and steps to reproduce it. Check log files for personal information before sharing them.

messages.title: Support ShroudForge
messages.message: Want to support ShroudForge's development? Feedback, issue reports, and an optional coffee help us improve the project and add features.
